booksDaily.title: Daily summary
booksDaily.sub: The daily figures the shop sends the ERP, how each was taken, and what needs you about them.
booksDaily.notLinked: The books with the ERP start when this store switches to the new ERP contract (v6) on the ERP's switch date. Until then nothing here changes and nothing is sent.
booksDaily.notRun: The nightly match has not run for this store yet. Each check shows its result after the first run.

check.TIES: Profit and loss ties to the account

result.PARTIAL: Matched as far as v6 allows

booksDaily.partialNote: Matched as far as v6 allows: the ERP does not yet give every number the shop asks for (row ids, the stored body hash). Everything it does give agrees.

need.TIE_BROKEN: The books do not tie on {date}: {amount} {order}
need.SUMMARY_REFUSED: The ERP refused the summary of {date}: {error}
need.SUMMARY_MISSING: {n} days have no summary yet, from {first}
need.SUMMARY_INCOMPLETE: {n} days still have figures not in yet, from {first}
need.FIXED_COSTS_MISSING: The fixed costs of {month} are not in yet
need.WAITING_CHECK_OLD: {pieces} returned pieces have waited {days} days for the owner's check in the ERP

kind.MISSING_EVENT: an ERP row the shop lacks
kind.UNKNOWN_ROW: a shop row the ERP lacks
kind.UNMATCHED_PAYMENT: a payment on one side only
kind.STALE_SUMMARY: the ERP holds an older summary

booksDaily.summaries: Daily summaries sent to the ERP
booksDaily.summariesSub: Built from the shop's own records at {time}, sent again by itself when a late fact changes an open day. Last accepted: {last}.
booksDaily.summariesEmpty: The first summary is built at the send time after the switch-over.
booksDaily.never: Nothing here moves money. A difference is put right only by a reversing entry and a new one, with the owner's PIN — never by changing a number.

status.title: Books status
status.notRunNote: The nightly match has not run for this store yet. The numbers show after the first run.
